name: STIHL MS 391
blurb: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on 3/8″ chain, .050″ gauge, 60–72 drive links, per STIHL's chain-selection chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 391 appears in STIHL's saw-chain selection chart with 16″, 18″ and 20″ guide bars: the same 3/8″ .050″ chain as the MS 311. Each row below restates the chart's drive-link count, chain marketing number and recommended bar part number. The STIHL chart we could read is dated 1 October 2017, so for any saw made after that, confirm against the bar stamp or STIHL's current chart before ordering.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 60 with recommended bar 3003 008 8913.
STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 66 with recommended bar 3003 008 8917.
STIHL's chart lists chain 33 RS3 72 with recommended bar 3003 008 8921.

sources.title: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (STIHL USA catalog page 173; specifications as of 1 October 2017) — recommended chain loop and guide bar per saw model
